corpus.text: HIL escalation triggers when an agent task has a risk score above 0.7 or when the task type requires human approval.
The SLA for HIL review is 4 hours. After the SLA expires, the task is auto-escalated to the operator.

corpus.text: On 2026-04-15, the team decided to use better-sqlite3 in WAL mode as the single shared SQLite DB.

corpus.text: The 4-tier salience decay formula is: decay_rate / (1 + LOG(1 + access_count)). High-access memories decay more slowly.

question: How does access count affect memory salience decay in MemroOS?
expected_answer: High-access memories decay more slowly because the decay rate is divided by (1 + LOG(1 + access_count)).

corpus.text: The LangGraph orchestration service is a Python process running separately from Next.js. Its checkpoint DB is data/orchestration.db.

expected_answer: To avoid cross-process lock contention. The LangGraph checkpoint DB (data/orchestration.db) is kept separate from the main MemroOS SQLite DB.
